Maira Kanhai

A Division Agent and the lead field perspective of Compromised's Gulf Coast crisis.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Gulf Coast assignment

Kanhai leads the novel's field cell as it follows attacks on the southern supply network toward the Texas Gulf Coast. [1]

Epilogue status

The book treats Kanhai's survival after the Battleship Texas operation as a major cliffhanger. The people holding her claim to be DHS, but the narrative does not verify that claim within this volume. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised places Maira Kanhai in charge of a Division cell sent from the Kansas Core to investigate attacks on southern food convoys and Texas refinery infrastructure. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The novel's epilogue reveals that Kanhai survives the Battleship Texas operation and wakes in the care of people presenting themselves as Department of Homeland Security personnel. [1]
